main: Each red polygon is derived from one active VIIRS Deep Blue L2 geolocated raw pixel.
The mask keeps only pixels with Aerosol Type 0, QA >= 2, and AOT550 >= 0.8.
Pixel footprints are estimated from neighboring swath geolocation centers instead of a coarse display grid.
supporting: This improves the medium-scale mask precision over the previous 120x58 display-cell rasterization.
Native L2 footprint area is computed from the polygon geometry in a local equirectangular approximation.
conflicting: This is still a raw science-value threshold adapter, not Dust-Mamba or Element84 learned segmentation.
Pixel footprint corners are estimated from adjacent geolocation centers, not official per-pixel corner arrays.
precursor: Use this footprint layer as the current high-precision medium-scale mask until a learned VIIRS/FY-4A dust model runs.

provenance.model_name: VIIRS Deep Blue native L2 footprint threshold adapter
limitations: Threshold adapter, not learned dust segmentation.
Footprint corners are estimated from adjacent geolocation centers.
Cloud/smoke/fire confounder model checks are not executed on this VIIRS swath.

display_policy: Display as real VIIRS Deep Blue L2 native-pixel footprint dust-support mask. Do not label as Dust-Mamba, Element84, or MODIS 3D-CNN model inference.
